subject: Compliance pathway and IR evidence — post-call next steps for Medica pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@medica-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps — security discovery & IR evidence for Medica pilot

Hi Eva,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement and security have what they need to move the pilot forward: 

1) Documents we can share today (attached):
   - SOC 2 Type II (redacted) from our 2025 audit — see SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf
   - Excerpt from our Incident Response playbook that covers detection, triage, notification timelines — IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf
   - Snapshot of our BCP/DR runbook for core inference services — BCP_runbook_snapshot.xlsx

2) Short answers to items you raised on the call:
   - SOC 2: Type II completed (Jan 2025). We undergo rolling quarterly reviews and will be initiating scope expansion later this year for private deployments.
   - Data residency / GDPR: We offer region tagging and customer-controlled VPC options; will share the GDPR data processing addendum template if helpful.
   - HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows via Private deployment and BAAs — we’ve executed BAAs with two prior customers; procurement template available.
   - Breach notification: Our IR playbook follows a 72-hour notification cadence for confirmed breaches where customer data is affected; we include forensic timeline and remediation steps in the notification bundle.

3) Ask from Medica (action items):
   - Please send your vendor intake form (your procurement mentioned a Medica template) and any specific evidence checklist you want prioritized.
   - Confirm which legal contacts should receive the BAA / NDA.

I attached a filled copy of our vendor questionnaire (vendor_questionnaire_filled.pdf) with high-level answers. Ben and Neha are looped for technical follow-up and to prepare any additional artifacts you request.

If you want a short follow-up call (30 min) to walk security through the playbook excerpts and timelines, Ben is available Tue/Wed mornings next week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this to procurement.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

---
Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf (pdf, redacted), IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf (pdf), BCP_runbook_snapshot.xlsx (xlsx), vendor_questionnaire_filled.pdf (pdf)

From: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@medica-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@medica-corp.com>, Medica Procurement <procurement@medica-corp.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — security discovery & IR evidence for Medica pilot

Thanks Hannah — that is helpful. I attached our Medica Vendor Intake Form for you to complete (medica_vendor_intake_form.pdf). A few clarifying questions from InfoSec and Legal: 

- Breach notification timeframe: you mentioned 72 hours for confirmed breaches. Do you have SLAs around time-to-detect or time-to-contain? We need to understand expected forensic log retention and whether Redwood can provide a forensic export (raw logs/KV cache at time T) if requested.

- Incident severity matrix: do you have an incident severity classification and examples we can reference for our escalation procedures?

- BAA / HIPAA: for the pilot we may ingest PHI. Please confirm if Redwood will sign a standard BAA and whether Private deployment is mandatory for PHI.

Procurement also asked if you can push the SOC 2 report to our secure vendor portal or share a one-time download link (we prefer not to receive PDF by email).

Once we have the filled intake form and your answers, procurement will begin the SOW/BAA checklist.

—Eva
Eva Thompson
Security & Privacy Lead, Medica Health
eva.thompson@medica-corp.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@medica-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — security discovery & IR evidence for Medica pilot

Eva — thanks, good questions. Answers below and I’ve attached the completed intake form.

- Time-to-detect / time-to-contain: our median MTTD (internal telemetry) for customer-impacting incidents is ~2.4 hours; MTTContain varies by incident but internal target is within 12 hours for incidents classified as Sev 1/2. We maintain application and control-plane logs for 90 days by default and up to 365 days for enterprise customers via extended retention.

- Forensic exports: we can provide time-bound exports of audit logs, request/response traces, and KV-cache snapshots when available. We treat exports as elevated requests and coordinate with legal; typical turnaround 3–7 business days depending on scope.

- Incident severity matrix: attached excerpt from the IR playbook includes our severity definitions and escalation paths (IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf).

- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA. For PHI, we recommend Private deployment or a dedicated tenancy configuration; we can discuss controls that make hosted offerings acceptable depending on your risk appetite.

- SOC 2 transfer: we can push a one-time secure download link to your vendor portal. Please confirm the upload method or share portal details (SFTP, secure SharePoint link, or a vendor-portal upload URL).

Attached: completed medica_vendor_intake_form.pdf and vendor_questionnaire_filled.pdf (redwood answers).

Let me know if you want any of these as redlined text for procurement. I can also set up a 30-minute technical walkthrough specifically for your InfoSec team — Ben can run it and go deeper on log types and retention.

Regards,
Hannah

---
Attachments: medica_vendor_intake_form.pdf (filled), vendor_questionnaire_filled.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@medica-corp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — security discovery & IR evidence for Medica pilot

Eva / Hannah — happy to run the walkthrough. Quick notes from an ops perspective:

- We classify incidents as Sev1 (production outage / data exfiltration), Sev2 (partial degradation / suspected unauthorized access), Sev3 (non-customer-impacting control issues). Our runbooks map actions to each level (TL;DR: Sev1 triggers on-call, communications cadence, and emergency postmortem).

- For evidence requests, we prepare a "forensics bundle" with timeline.csv, log_export.tar.gz (redacted where necessary), and a remediation summary. We can stage a sample bundle for your review to show format and redaction policy.

- Availability for walkthrough: Tue 08/10 09:00–11:00 PT or Wed 08/11 10:00–12:00 PT.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Carlos Vega <c.vega@medica-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Eva Thompson <eva.thompson@medica-corp.com>, Medica Procurement <procurement@medica-corp.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — security discovery & IR evidence for Medica pilot

Thanks — that addresses most of our questions. A couple remaining items before we route to procurement: 

- Please upload the SOC 2 PDF to our vendor portal (portal upload link: https://vendors.medica-corp.com/upload). We will not be able to accept SOC reports via regular email.

- Procurement wants an estimated turnaround time for any forensic export requests so they can include it in the SOW (please provide worst-case and typical timelines). You gave 3–7 business days earlier — can you confirm worst-case is 10 business days for complex exports?

- For the BAA, please send your standard BAA to procurement@medica-corp.com so we can start legal review in parallel. Prefer DocuSign once the draft is agreed.

If you can push the SOC 2 link and the BAA to procurement today, we will queue the review and aim to return a comment set within 5–7 business days.

Thanks,
Carlos Vega
Vendor Manager, Medica Health
procurement@medica-corp.com

---
Requested uploads: SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf -> https://vendors.medica-corp.com/upload; BAA (DocuSign) to procurement@medica-corp.com
